## The contract (pinned; A is coding against this verbatim)

src/calc.js is an ES module whose every export line starts with `export ` at column 0; the build strips that prefix and inlines the result as a classic script. It exports:

- ASSUMPTION_NOTES: [ { key, value:string, rationale, source, confidence, lastChecked } ]  (construction system, concrete grade, the "list every space" rule — show these as read-only text at the top of the assumptions panel)
- LIMITS: { floors:[1,4], wallHeightM:[2.4,4.5], roomSideM:[1,20], rooms:[1,40], areaM2:[30,1500] }  (use for input min/max/step attributes)
- SAMPLE_HOUSE: { floors, wallHeightM, rooms:[{name,lengthM,widthM}] }
- generateRooms(areaM2) → rooms[]  (throws plain-English Error outside LIMITS)
- validateHouse(house) → house  (throws plain-English Error)
- estimate(house, overrides={}) → { inputs:{ floors, wallHeightM, roomCount, floorAreaM2, builtUpAreaM2, extWallLengthM, intWallLengthM, grossWallAreaM2, netWallAreaM2, extWallAreaM2, intWallAreaM2 }, elements:{ footings, groundSlab, columns, beams, slabs, wallsExternal, wallsInternal — each { label, concreteM3, steelKg, blocks, wastagePct, costOmr } }, totals:{ blocks, blocksExternal, blocksInternal, concreteM3, steelKg, steelTonnes, costOmr, costBlocksOmr, costConcreteOmr, costSteelOmr }, assumptionsUsed:[ { key, label, value, unit, defaultValue, overridden, source, sourceUrl, confidence, lastChecked } ], notes:[string] }

## src/page.html

- `<!--CALC-->` — the build replaces it with `<script>` + calc.js (export prefixes stripped) + `</script>`. Your page script must come AFTER it and call the globals estimate, DEFAULTS, etc. directly.
- `<!--BUILDLOG-->` — the build replaces it with `<script type="application/json" id="build-log">[...records...]</script>`. Your page script reads and JSON.parses that element and renders section 2 from it (records: { order:number, agent, model, round, startedAt, finishedAt?, prompt, report?, outcome? }; sort by order then round; the order field can be like 4 for both "04a" and "04b" so ALSO sort by the record's `file` field which the build adds as the filename stem, e.g. "04a-builder"). Everything the estimator shows on screen comes from estimate()'s return value — format numbers with thousands separators and units, steel as tonnes with 1 decimal (kg in a title attribute), OMR with 0 decimals, m³ with 1 decimal. ## scripts/build.mjs

Must be idempotent (same inputs → byte-identical output) because the verify recipe runs `git diff --exit-code -- index.html`.
